rationale: Sharing a deployment-manifest template does not establish a shared internal incident-ticket prefix. The mapping states no connection between template identity and ticket prefixes, and the reproduction signals provide no evidence about those prefixes.

signal_basis.exact_text: The focal and comparison deployments use the same deployment-manifest template.
Manifest-template identity is the only stated cross-deployment connection; code, component semantics and failure mechanisms are not stipulated equal.
